entry.summary: No visa for tourist visits up to 90 days in a 6-month period.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: Serbia's currency is the Serbian Dinar (RSD). You can't change it outside Serbia. On arrival, you'll need to declare currency and valuables worth 10,000 euros or equivalent value. Valuables may include: laptops cameras jewellery Make sure you get a copy from customs officials. You'll need the declaration form when you leave Serbia. They could be taken away if you don't declare your currency or valuables. Most banks in towns and cities have ATMs that accept international bank cards. ATMs only dispense Serbian Dinar. In limited locations, ATMs may dispense euros. Traveller's cheques aren't widel

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include long prison terms in local jails.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: It's illegal to photograph military and police: personnel buildings vehicles equipment
laws.heading: Photography

laws.rule: To drive, you'll need both: a current Australian driver's licence (digital driver's licences may not be accepted) a valid international driving permit (IDP) Get your IDP before you leave Australia. Driving without an IDP could void your travel and vehicle insurance.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Same-sex relationships are legal but not widely accepted. Verbal and physical aggression is sometimes directed towards the LGBTQIA+ community. Avoid public displays of affection.
